Characters:傭.sentence: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。
Characters:傭.translation: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

chinese.text: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。

english.text: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

Characters:割.sentence: 在你面前有一百万美金。你可以自己留下或帮一个你不认识的快全身瘫痪的人做手术。他不认识你，你也不认识他。当然，无论你慷慨地把所有的钱都捐给了一个素不相识的人去做手术，还是卑鄙地拿走这笔钱，让那个人今生都只能卧床不起，都不会有人知道。你会怎么做呢？这笔钱不可割分。
Characters:割.translation: There's a million dollars in front of you. You can keep it for yourself or pay with it for a surgery for a person you don't know who is in danger of becoming paralysed. You don't know each other. No one will ever know how nobly you acted by giving away all the money for a stranger's surgery, or what base choice you made to take the money confining that person to a wheelchair for the rest of their life. What would you do? Sharing the money is not an option.

Characters:創.sentence: ​我們​來​自​世界​各​地，有​不​同​的​文化​背景，説​不​同​的​語言。可是，我們​十分​團結，大家​都​有​同樣​的​目標。最​重要​的​是，我們​都​渴望​尊榮​耶和華，耶和華​就是​聖經​所​説​的​上帝，他​是​萬物​的​創造主。我們​盡力​效法​耶穌基督，以​身​為​基督徒​為​榮。我們​每​個​人​都​常常​花​時間​幫助​別人​認識​聖經​和​上帝​的​王國。由於​我們​為​耶和華​上帝​和​他​的​王國​作​見證，也​就是​向​別人​傳講​上帝​和​他​王國​的​真理，所以​我們​稱​為​耶和華見證人。
Characters:創.translation: We come from hundreds of ethnic and language backgrounds, yet we are united by common goals. Above all, we want to honor Jehovah, the God of the Bible and the Creator of all things. We do our best to imitate Jesus Christ and are proud to be called Christians. Each of us regularly spends time helping people learn about the Bible and God’s Kingdom. Because we witness, or talk, about Jehovah God and his Kingdom, we are known as Jehovah’s Witnesses.

chinese.text: ​我們​來​自​世界​各​地，有​不​同​的​文化​背景，説​不​同​的​語言。可是，我們​十分​團結，大家​都​有​同樣​的​目標。最​重要​的​是，我們​都​渴望​尊榮​耶和華，耶和華​就是​聖經​所​説​的​上帝，他​是​萬物​的​創造主。我們​盡力​效法​耶穌基督，以​身​為​基督徒​為​榮。我們​每​個​人​都​常常​花​時間​幫助​別人​認識​聖經​和​上帝​的​王國。由於​我們​為​耶和華​上帝​和​他​的​王國​作​見證，也​就是​向​別人​傳講​上帝​和​他​王國​的​真理，所以​我們​稱​為​耶和華見證人。

english.text: We come from hundreds of ethnic and language backgrounds, yet we are united by common goals. Above all, we want to honor Jehovah, the God of the Bible and the Creator of all things. We do our best to imitate Jesus Christ and are proud to be called Christians. Each of us regularly spends time helping people learn about the Bible and God’s Kingdom. Because we witness, or talk, about Jehovah God and his Kingdom, we are known as Jehovah’s Witnesses.

Characters:卑.sentence: 在你面前有一百万美金。你可以自己留下或帮一个你不认识的快全身瘫痪的人做手术。他不认识你，你也不认识他。当然，无论你慷慨地把所有的钱都捐给了一个素不相识的人去做手术，还是卑鄙地拿走这笔钱，让那个人今生都只能卧床不起，都不会有人知道。你会怎么做呢？这笔钱不可割分。
Characters:卑.translation: There's a million dollars in front of you. You can keep it for yourself or pay with it for a surgery for a person you don't know who is in danger of becoming paralysed. You don't know each other. No one will ever know how nobly you acted by giving away all the money for a stranger's surgery, or what base choice you made to take the money confining that person to a wheelchair for the rest of their life. What would you do? Sharing the money is not an option.

Characters:團.sentence: ​我們​來​自​世界​各​地，有​不​同​的​文化​背景，説​不​同​的​語言。可是，我們​十分​團結，大家​都​有​同樣​的​目標。最​重要​的​是，我們​都​渴望​尊榮​耶和華，耶和華​就是​聖經​所​説​的​上帝，他​是​萬物​的​創造主。我們​盡力​效法​耶穌基督，以​身​為​基督徒​為​榮。我們​每​個​人​都​常常​花​時間​幫助​別人​認識​聖經​和​上帝​的​王國。由於​我們​為​耶和華​上帝​和​他​的​王國​作​見證，也​就是​向​別人​傳講​上帝​和​他​王國​的​真理，所以​我們​稱​為​耶和華見證人。
Characters:團.translation: We come from hundreds of ethnic and language backgrounds, yet we are united by common goals. Above all, we want to honor Jehovah, the God of the Bible and the Creator of all things. We do our best to imitate Jesus Christ and are proud to be called Christians. Each of us regularly spends time helping people learn about the Bible and God’s Kingdom. Because we witness, or talk, about Jehovah God and his Kingdom, we are known as Jehovah’s Witnesses.

chinese.text: ​我們​來​自​世界​各​地，有​不​同​的​文化​背景，説​不​同​的​語言。可是，我們​十分​團結，大家​都​有​同樣​的​目標。最​重要​的​是，我們​都​渴望​尊榮​耶和華，耶和華​就是​聖經​所​説​的​上帝，他​是​萬物​的​創造主。我們​盡力​效法​耶穌基督，以​身​為​基督徒​為​榮。我們​每​個​人​都​常常​花​時間​幫助​別人​認識​聖經​和​上帝​的​王國。由於​我們​為​耶和華​上帝​和​他​的​王國​作​見證，也​就是​向​別人​傳講​上帝​和​他​王國​的​真理，所以​我們​稱​為​耶和華見證人。

Because we witness, or talk, about Jehovah God and his Kingdom, we are known as Jehovah’s Witnesses.

Characters:奎.sentence: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。
Characters:奎.translation: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

english.text: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

Characters:巷.sentence: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。
Characters:巷.translation: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

chinese.text: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。

english.text: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

Characters:廣.sentence: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。
Characters:廣.translation: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

chinese.text: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。

english.text: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

Characters:慨.sentence: 在你面前有一百万美金。你可以自己留下或帮一个你不认识的快全身瘫痪的人做手术。他不认识你，你也不认识他。当然，无论你慷慨地把所有的钱都捐给了一个素不相识的人去做手术，还是卑鄙地拿走这笔钱，让那个人今生都只能卧床不起，都不会有人知道。你会怎么做呢？这笔钱不可割分。
Characters:慨.translation: There's a million dollars in front of you. You can keep it for yourself or pay with it for a surgery for a person you don't know who is in danger of becoming paralysed. You don't know each other. No one will ever know how nobly you acted by giving away all the money for a stranger's surgery, or what base choice you made to take the money confining that person to a wheelchair for the rest of their life. What would you do? Sharing the money is not an option.

No one will ever know how nobly you acted by giving away all the money for a stranger's surgery, or what base choice you made to take the money confining that person to a wheelchair for the rest of their life. What would you do? Sharing the money is not an option.

Characters:憤.sentence: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。
Characters:憤.translation: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

Characters:柏.sentence: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。
Characters:柏.translation: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

Characters:痪.sentence: 在你面前有一百万美金。你可以自己留下或帮一个你不认识的快全身瘫痪的人做手术。他不认识你，你也不认识他。当然，无论你慷慨地把所有的钱都捐给了一个素不相识的人去做手术，还是卑鄙地拿走这笔钱，让那个人今生都只能卧床不起，都不会有人知道。你会怎么做呢？这笔钱不可割分。
Characters:痪.translation: There's a million dollars in front of you. You can keep it for yourself or pay with it for a surgery for a person you don't know who is in danger of becoming paralysed. You don't know each other. No one will ever know how nobly you acted by giving away all the money for a stranger's surgery, or what base choice you made to take the money confining that person to a wheelchair for the rest of their life. What would you do? Sharing the money is not an option.

Characters:督.sentence: ​我們​來​自​世界​各​地，有​不​同​的​文化​背景，説​不​同​的​語言。可是，我們​十分​團結，大家​都​有​同樣​的​目標。最​重要​的​是，我們​都​渴望​尊榮​耶和華，耶和華​就是​聖經​所​説​的​上帝，他​是​萬物​的​創造主。我們​盡力​效法​耶穌基督，以​身​為​基督徒​為​榮。我們​每​個​人​都​常常​花​時間​幫助​別人​認識​聖經​和​上帝​的​王國。由於​我們​為​耶和華​上帝​和​他​的​王國​作​見證，也​就是​向​別人​傳講​上帝​和​他​王國​的​真理，所以​我們​稱​為​耶和華見證人。
Characters:督.translation: We come from hundreds of ethnic and language backgrounds, yet we are united by common goals. Above all, we want to honor Jehovah, the God of the Bible and the Creator of all things. We do our best to imitate Jesus Christ and are proud to be called Christians. Each of us regularly spends time helping people learn about the Bible and God’s Kingdom. Because we witness, or talk, about Jehovah God and his Kingdom, we are known as Jehovah’s Witnesses.

Characters:砸.sentence: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。
Characters:砸.translation: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

Characters:磁.translation: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

Characters:穌.sentence: ​我們​來​自​世界​各​地，有​不​同​的​文化​背景，説​不​同​的​語言。可是，我們​十分​團結，大家​都​有​同樣​的​目標。最​重要​的​是，我們​都​渴望​尊榮​耶和華，耶和華​就是​聖經​所​説​的​上帝，他​是​萬物​的​創造主。我們​盡力​效法​耶穌基督，以​身​為​基督徒​為​榮。我們​每​個​人​都​常常​花​時間​幫助​別人​認識​聖經​和​上帝​的​王國。由於​我們​為​耶和華​上帝​和​他​的​王國​作​見證，也​就是​向​別人​傳講​上帝​和​他​王國​的​真理，所以​我們​稱​為​耶和華見證人。
Characters:穌.translation: We come from hundreds of ethnic and language backgrounds, yet we are united by common goals. Above all, we want to honor Jehovah, the God of the Bible and the Creator of all things. We do our best to imitate Jesus Christ and are proud to be called Christians. Each of us regularly spends time helping people learn about the Bible and God’s Kingdom. Because we witness, or talk, about Jehovah God and his Kingdom, we are known as Jehovah’s Witnesses.

Characters:筒.sentence: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。
Characters:筒.translation: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

Characters:絆.sentence: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。
Characters:絆.translation: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

english.text: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

Characters:縱.sentence: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。
Characters:縱.translation: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

chinese.text: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。

english.text: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

Characters:耶.sentence: ​我們​來​自​世界​各​地，有​不​同​的​文化​背景，説​不​同​的​語言。可是，我們​十分​團結，大家​都​有​同樣​的​目標。最​重要​的​是，我們​都​渴望​尊榮​耶和華，耶和華​就是​聖經​所​説​的​上帝，他​是​萬物​的​創造主。我們​盡力​效法​耶穌基督，以​身​為​基督徒​為​榮。我們​每​個​人​都​常常​花​時間​幫助​別人​認識​聖經​和​上帝​的​王國。由於​我們​為​耶和華​上帝​和​他​的​王國​作​見證，也​就是​向​別人​傳講​上帝​和​他​王國​的​真理，所以​我們​稱​為​耶和華見證人。
Characters:耶.translation: We come from hundreds of ethnic and language backgrounds, yet we are united by common goals. Above all, we want to honor Jehovah, the God of the Bible and the Creator of all things. We do our best to imitate Jesus Christ and are proud to be called Christians. Each of us regularly spends time helping people learn about the Bible and God’s Kingdom. Because we witness, or talk, about Jehovah God and his Kingdom, we are known as Jehovah’s Witnesses.

chinese.text: ​我們​來​自​世界​各​地，有​不​同​的​文化​背景，説​不​同​的​語言。可是，我們​十分​團結，大家​都​有​同樣​的​目標。最​重要​的​是，我們​都​渴望​尊榮​耶和華，耶和華​就是​聖經​所​説​的​上帝，他​是​萬物​的​創造主。我們​盡力​效法​耶穌基督，以​身​為​基督徒​為​榮。我們​每​個​人​都​常常​花​時間​幫助​別人​認識​聖經​和​上帝​的​王國。由於​我們​為​耶和華​上帝​和​他​的​王國​作​見證，也​就是​向​別人​傳講​上帝​和​他​王國​的​真理，所以​我們​稱​為​耶和華見證人。

We do our best to imitate Jesus Christ and are proud to be called Christians. Each of us regularly spends time helping people learn about the Bible and God’s Kingdom. Because we witness, or talk, about Jehovah God and his Kingdom, we are known as Jehovah’s Witnesses.

Characters:膝.sentence: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。
Characters:膝.translation: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

english.text: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

Characters:蓋.sentence: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。
Characters:蓋.translation: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

chinese.text: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。

english.text: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

Characters:貝.sentence: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。
Characters:貝.translation: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.

Characters:賓.sentence: 我在黑暗的巷子中絆倒，膝蓋砸在柏油路上。一塊木板蓋著巷弄的房屋之間的電線。深夜的巷弄非常之暗。我的眼鏡從眼睛上掉了下來。幸好有一位帶著手電筒的廣東工人幫忙。我的膝蓋只是擦破了皮。我想起另一次膝蓋摔傷是在菲律賓奎松市的唐荷西高地。那裡有一大片火星般的紅土地，遍地長滿了「塔拉希布」草。有時工人會故意縱火燒草。我和哥哥當時還在外面玩。那時我們還未到青春期。在燃燒的野草旁，我摔倒了，膝蓋著地。我的貝貝姥姥憤怒不已。家裡的女傭在車庫後面的大磁磚水槽裡幫我清洗了雙腿。
Characters:賓.translation: I tripped in the alleyway in the darkness, as I crashed my knees on the asphalt. There was a wooden board that covered a wire between houses across the alleyway. It was very dark there at night. My eyeglasses fell off my face. Luckily, a Cantonese labourer with a flashlight helped me. My knees just got scraped. I remember another time when I crashed on my knees. It was at Don José Heights in Quezon City in the Philippines. There was a vastness of Martianesque red soil, wherein the "talahib" grass grew. Sometimes, workers intentionally set the grass on fire. My brother and I were still playing, even then, outside. We were still prepubescent. Near burning grass, I stumbled on my knees. My grandmother, Lola Bebe, was so angry. A maid washed my legs in the big tiled sink behind the garage.
